# Psalm 69 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Upon Shoshannim [Lilies]. Of-David.

**2** Save-me, O-God, for the-waters have-come up to my-soul.

**3** I-have-sunk in-mire of-depth, and-there-is-no standing; I-have-come into-depths of-waters, and-the-flood sweeps-over-me.

**4** I-am-weary with-my-calling; my-throat is-parched. My-eyes fail while-I-wait for-my-God.

**5** More than-the-hairs of-my-head [are] those-hating-me without-cause. Mighty [are] those-who-would-destroy-me, my-enemies falsely. What I-did-not steal, then I-must-restore.

**6** O-God, You know my-foolishness, and-my-guilt-offerings from-You are-not hidden.

**7** Let-not be-put-to-shame through-me those-who-wait for-You, O-Lord YHWH of-hosts. Let-not be-humiliated through-me those-who-seek-You, O-God of-Israel.

**8** For on-Your-account I-bear reproach; shame covers my-face.

**9** A-stranger I-have-become to-my-brothers, and-a-foreigner to-the-sons of-my-mother.

**10** For the-zeal of-Your-house has-consumed-me, and-the-reproaches of-those-reproaching-You have-fallen on-me.

**11** And-I-wept in-fasting my-soul, and-it-was for-reproaches to-me.

**12** And-I-made my-clothing sackcloth, and-I-became to-them a-byword.

**13** Those-sitting [in the] gate talk about-me, and-[I am] the-songs of-drinkers-of strong-drink.

**14** But-as-for-me — my-prayer [is] to-You, YHWH, at-an-acceptable time. O-God, in-the-abundance of-Your-steadfast-love, answer-me in-the-truth of-Your-salvation.

**15** Deliver-me from-the-mire and-do-not let-me sink; let-me-be-delivered from-those-hating-me and-from-the-depths of-waters.

**16** Let-not the-flood of-waters sweep-over-me, and-let-not the-deep swallow-me, and-let-not the-pit close its-mouth over-me.

**17** Answer-me, YHWH, for good [is] Your-steadfast-love; according-to the-abundance of-Your-compassions turn to-me.

**18** And-do-not hide Your-face from-Your-servant, for distress [is] to-me; quickly answer-me.

**19** Draw-near to-my-soul; redeem-it; because-of my-enemies ransom-me.

**20** You know my-reproach and-my-shame and-my-dishonor; before-You [are] all my-adversaries.

**21** Reproach has-broken my-heart, and-I-am-sick. And-I-hoped for-sympathy, but-there-was-none; and-for-comforters, but-I-found none.

**22** And-they-gave for-my-food poison, and-for-my-thirst they-gave-me-to-drink vinegar.

**23** Let-their-table before-them become a-trap, and-for-[their]-allies a-snare.

**24** Let-their-eyes be-darkened from-seeing, and-their-loins make-tremble continually.

**25** Pour-out upon-them Your-indignation, and-the-burning of-Your-anger overtake-them.

**26** Let-their-encampment be-desolate; in-their-tents let-there-be no-one dwelling.

**27** For [the one] whom You have-struck they-persecute, and-to-the-pain of-Your-wounded-ones they-add.

**28** Add iniquity upon their-iniquity, and-let-them-not come into-Your-righteousness.

**29** Let-them-be-blotted-out from-the-book of-life, and-with the-righteous let-them-not be-written.

**30** But-I [am] afflicted and-in-pain; Your-salvation, O-God, sets-me-on-high.

**31** I-will-praise the-name of-God with-a-song, and-I-will-magnify-Him with-thanksgiving.

**32** And-it-will-please YHWH more-than an-ox, a-bull with-horns and-hooves.

**33** The-humble see [it and] are-glad; you-who-seek God — let-your-hearts live.

**34** For YHWH hears the-needy, and-His-prisoners He-does-not despise.

**35** Let-heaven and-earth praise-Him, the-seas and-everything moving in-them.

**36** For God saves Zion and-builds the-cities of-Judah, and-they-dwell there and-possess-it.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **69:10**: Jesus' disciples remembered this verse when He cleansed the temple (John 2:17) — 'Zeal for Your house has consumed me.'

- **69:22**: The vinegar offered to Jesus on the cross (Matt 27:48) echoes this verse. Psalm 69 is the second-most quoted psalm in the NT after Psalm 22.

— EMET
